news.titleEn: Trump waives broad new Russia sanctions, Zelenskyy condemns it as 'wrong'
news.conclusionEn: Trump signed an executive order late Friday waiving the core tariff provisions of the Graham Act on Russia, two days before they were due to take effect.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普签令豁免对俄新制裁，生效前两天叫停
news.whyEn: The waiver removes the threat of up to 500% tariffs on Russian goods and up to 100% tariffs on top buyers of Russian oil like China and India, reshaping energy trade and the Ukraine war calculus.
news.whyZh: 中印等俄油大买家免遭最高100%关税，能源贸易与俄乌局势都受影响
news.detailEn: The Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, signed into law in September, required tariffs of up to 500% on all Russian imports and up to 100% on the top five buyers of Russian crude or gas. Trump certified to Congress that waiving them is in the national interest, while keeping earlier sanctions in place. It is the second Russia sanctions waiver in two weeks as the White House seeks relief from rising diesel prices. Zelenskyy said the move 'only helps the Russians,' and lawmakers from both parties criticized it, so a congressional pushback is possible.
news.detailZh: 9月生效的《格雷厄姆制裁俄罗斯和伊朗法案》要求对所有俄国商品加征最高500%关税，并对俄油气前五大买家加征最高100%关税。特朗普向国会证明豁免符合国家利益，但保留了此前已有的对俄制裁。这是两周内第二次豁免对俄制裁，白宫意在缓解柴油价格上涨。泽连斯基批评此举「只对俄罗斯有利」，两党议员也纷纷反对，国会可能出手反制。

news.titleEn: Brent oil touches $110 as Iran escalates Hormuz attacks, Ukraine vows to hit Russian refineries
news.conclusionEn: Brent hit $110 for the first time since May and closed at $109.86, while WTI settled at $101.41 after jumping more than 10% on the week.
news.conclusionZh: 布油触及110美元，WTI单周涨超10%
news.whyEn: Oil above $100 feeds directly into inflation, pressures central banks to stay hawkish and weighs on airlines, shipping and energy-importing economies.
news.whyZh: 油价破百推高通胀，央行难以宽松，航空航运和能源进口国承压
news.detailEn: At least nine tankers and cargo ships were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz in a week, and Iran sank the Singapore-registered container ship GFS Pride. Houthi militants fired missiles at Saudi Arabia, including one aimed at the Yanbu export terminal, while Ukraine vowed to keep hitting Russian refineries. Crude exports through Hormuz fell to about 9.4 million barrels a day, roughly 70% of pre-war levels. A lasting fall in the risk premium likely requires a US-Iran agreement.
news.detailZh: 一周内霍尔木兹海峡至少九艘油轮和货船遭袭，伊朗击沉了新加坡籍集装箱船GFS Pride。胡塞武装向沙特发射导弹，其中一枚瞄准延布石油出口码头；乌克兰也表示将继续打击俄罗斯炼油厂。经霍尔木兹的原油出口降至约每天940万桶，约为战前的70%。风险溢价要真正回落，可能需要美伊达成协议。

news.titleEn: Why Tech's AI Borrowing Binge Is Rattling Markets
news.conclusionEn: Credit default swap prices for Microsoft, Nvidia, Meta and Amazon have surged, in some cases more than doubling, as investors question whether AI spending will pay off.
news.conclusionZh: 科技巨头CDS价格飙升，市场质疑AI举债回报
news.whyEn: Rising default-protection costs for the world's biggest companies signal that the AI trade is shifting from equity euphoria to credit-market scrutiny, which can raise borrowing costs for the whole buildout.
news.whyZh: 巨头违约保护成本上升，说明AI热潮正受信用市场审视，融资成本或上升
news.detailEn: Hyperscalers have been issuing record amounts of bonds and off-balance-sheet debt to fund data centers and chips. Chipmakers fell for an eighth straight day this week, and the Nasdaq lost almost 5% on the week. Wider CDS spreads mean lenders want more compensation for the risk that AI revenue falls short of the capital spent. Upcoming earnings from Meta and Tesla next week will be a key test of investor confidence.
news.detailZh: 大型云厂商为建数据中心和采购芯片，发行了创纪录规模的债券和表外债务。本周芯片股连跌八天，纳指单周下跌近5%。CDS利差扩大，意味着债权人要求更多补偿，以防AI收入跟不上资本投入。下周Meta和特斯拉的财报将是检验投资者信心的关键。

news.titleEn: US Interest Costs Hit Record $1 Trillion, Risking Debt Snowball
news.conclusionEn: US net interest payments topped $1 trillion for the first time in fiscal 2026, as the annual deficit came in near $2 trillion.
news.conclusionZh: 美国年度利息支出首破1万亿美元
news.whyEn: Interest is now one of the largest federal budget items, raising fears of a self-reinforcing debt spiral and keeping pressure on Treasury yields.
news.whyZh: 利息已成联邦预算最大项之一，债务滚雪球风险推高美债收益率
news.detailEn: Net interest costs reached about $1.05 trillion in the fiscal year through September, up more than 8% from fiscal 2025. The full-year deficit was about $1.99 trillion, roughly 6% of GDP, and gross debt is above $40 trillion. Interest now costs more than Medicare or the defense budget. Higher deficits mean more Treasury issuance, which may keep long-term yields and mortgage rates elevated.
news.detailZh: 截至9月的财年，净利息支出约1.05万亿美元，比2025财年增长超8%。全年赤字约1.99万亿美元，约占GDP的6%，总债务已超40万亿美元。利息支出如今已超过联邦医疗保险和国防预算。赤字扩大意味着美债发行增加，长期收益率和房贷利率可能维持高位。

news.titleEn: IMFC chair says global economy resilient; delegates walk out on Russian official
news.conclusionEn: The IMF's steering committee closed its Bangkok meetings saying the global economy is resilient but warning against complacency, as nearly half of delegates walked out on Russia's finance minister.
news.conclusionZh: IMF称全球经济有韧性，近半代表退席抗议俄方
news.whyEn: The joint statement flags wars, energy and food security, high public debt and AI risks as the main threats, setting the tone for global policy coordination.
news.whyZh: 声明点名战争、能源粮食安全、高债务和AI风险，为全球政策定调
news.detailEn: Saudi Finance Minister Mohammed Al-Jadaan, chair of the International Monetary and Financial Committee, said all members agreed to the chair's statement despite the walkout. The statement warned that conflicts and trade tensions could disrupt trade routes and push up refined energy prices. Fiscal authorities were urged to rebuild buffers while protecting vulnerable groups. The week-long meetings drew more than 18,000 people to Bangkok.
news.detailZh: 国际货币与金融委员会主席、沙特财长贾丹表示，尽管有代表退席，全体成员仍通过了主席声明。声明警告，冲突和贸易紧张可能扰乱贸易通道并推高成品油价格。各国财政当局被要求重建财政缓冲，同时保护弱势群体。为期一周的年会吸引了超过1.8万人到访曼谷。

news.titleEn: Mass protests in France spiral into worst riots in years
news.conclusionEn: Hundreds of thousands protested across France over living costs on Saturday, with riots, arson at city halls and about 400 arrests.
news.conclusionZh: 法国生活成本抗议演变为多年来最严重骚乱
news.whyEn: Social unrest deepens France's fiscal and political crisis ahead of next year's presidential election and could unsettle French bonds and the euro.
news.whyZh: 加深法国财政与政治危机，或冲击法债和欧元，明年大选前更添变数
news.detailEn: Officials put turnout at about 550,000, while the CGT union estimated 800,000. Limoges city hall was set ablaze, Marseille's city hall was broken into and Lyon's tourist office was torched. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu blamed the far left and said the government would not be intimidated, and Macron vowed prosecutions. Smaller protests also took place in Belgium, Portugal and Italy as living costs rise across Europe.
news.detailZh: 官方统计约55万人参加，CGT工会估计达80万。利摩日市政厅被纵火，马赛市政厅遭闯入，里昂旅游局被焚。总理勒科尔尼指责极左势力，称政府不会被恐吓，马克龙也誓言追究责任。随着欧洲生活成本上涨，比利时、葡萄牙和意大利也出现了规模较小的抗议。

news.titleEn: US and Iran both claim control of Strait of Hormuz amid attacks on vessels
news.conclusionEn: At least 12 ships were attacked near Hormuz in the week to October 16, making October the worst month for shipping attacks since the Iran war began.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹本月遭袭船只数创开战以来新高
news.whyEn: With both Washington and Tehran claiming authority over the strait, shipping insurance, freight rates and energy flows face prolonged uncertainty.
news.whyZh: 美伊都声称掌控海峡，航运保险、运费和能源供应将长期不确定
news.detailEn: UKMTO said it confirmed 12 attacks but believes the true number is higher because most targeted vessels are not reporting. Two vessels hit naval mines this week. The US says the strait is controlled by it and its regional partners and has redirected more than 130 vessels under its blockade, while Iran says Hormuz will reopen only if US forces leave the region. Stalled reopening talks mean the risk premium in oil is likely to persist.
news.detailZh: 英国海事贸易行动办公室确认了12起袭击，但认为实际数字更高，因为多数受袭船只没有上报。本周有两艘船触碰水雷。美方称海峡由美国及其地区伙伴控制，并已依据封锁令拦截改道130多艘船；伊朗则表示只有美军撤出该地区，海峡才会重新开放。重开谈判陷入僵局，油价风险溢价可能持续。

news.titleEn: Hurricane Trudy strengthens to Category 2 as it approaches Mexico coast
news.conclusionEn: Hurricane Trudy strengthened to Category 2 with 100 mph winds as it neared Mexico's Pacific coast, while Typhoon Champi reached Category 4 heading toward Guam.
news.conclusionZh: 飓风特鲁迪升至2级逼近墨西哥，台风尚皮升至4级
news.whyEn: Saturated ground along Mexico's Pacific coast raises the risk of floods and landslides, and Champi threatens a key US military hub in Guam.
news.whyZh: 墨西哥太平洋沿岸洪水滑坡风险高，台风威胁美军关岛基地
news.detailEn: A hurricane warning ran from Manzanillo in Colima to Cabo Corrientes in Jalisco, per the US National Hurricane Center. Trudy was expected to pass near the coast into Sunday. Mexico's Navy urged extreme caution over high waves, heavy rain and rising rivers. Officials warned that repeated storms had already soaked the ground, raising damage risk even from rainfall alone.
news.detailZh: 据美国国家飓风中心，飓风警报覆盖科利马州曼萨尼约至哈利斯科州科连特斯角。特鲁迪预计周日前后贴近海岸经过。墨西哥海军提醒民众高度警惕巨浪、暴雨和河水上涨。官员警告，接连的风暴已让土壤饱和，仅降雨就可能造成破坏。

businessTips.explanationEn: A pre-mortem is a planning exercise where a team imagines a project has already failed and works backward to list the reasons why. Because failure is assumed, people feel safer raising doubts they would normally keep quiet. It counters overconfidence and groupthink before money and time are committed. It takes about 30 minutes and works for launches, hires and investments.
businessTips.explanationZh: 事前验尸是一种规划方法：团队先假设项目已经失败，再倒推列出失败原因。因为失败已是「前提」，大家更敢说出平时不愿讲的担忧。它能在投入资金和时间之前对抗过度自信和群体思维。整个过程大约30分钟，适用于产品发布、招聘和投资决策。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before launching a new subscription box, a founder asks the team: 'It's six months later and this flopped — why?' Answers like 'shipping costs ate our margin' and 'churn after month two' lead to testing prices and adding a retention offer before launch.
businessTips.exampleZh: 推出新订阅盒前，创始人问团队：「假设半年后失败了，原因是什么？」大家答「运费吃掉了利润」「第二个月后大量退订」，于是上线前先测试定价，并加入挽留优惠。

businessTips.explanationEn: Affiliate marketing means earning a commission by recommending other companies' products through a tracked link or code. You don't hold inventory, handle shipping or provide customer service, so startup costs are close to zero. Income depends on audience trust and how well the product fits their needs. Commission rates range from a few percent for physical goods to 20-50% for software and digital courses.
businessTips.explanationZh: 联盟营销是通过专属链接或优惠码推荐其他公司的产品并赚取佣金。你不需要囤货、发货或做客服，启动成本几乎为零。收入取决于受众的信任度以及产品是否契合他们的需求。佣金比例从实物商品的几个百分点到软件和网课的20%-50%不等。
businessTips.exampleEn: Someone who runs a small blog about home coffee brewing writes honest grinder comparisons with affiliate links. If 2,000 monthly readers convert at 2% on a $200 grinder with a 5% commission, that's about $400 a month, which grows as old posts keep ranking.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位写家庭手冲咖啡博客的人，发布磨豆机真实测评并附上联盟链接。每月2000名读者、2%转化率、200美元产品、5%佣金，约每月400美元，而且旧文章持续带来流量，收入会逐步累积。

businessTips.explanationEn: A credit default swap is like insurance on a borrower's debt: the buyer pays a regular premium, and the seller pays out if the borrower defaults. The premium, quoted in basis points per year, rises when the market sees more credit risk. CDS prices often move before stock prices or credit ratings, making them an early warning signal. They are watched for companies, banks and even governments.
businessTips.explanationZh: 信用违约互换相当于为借款人的债务买保险：买方定期支付保费，若借款人违约，卖方负责赔付。保费以每年多少基点报价，市场认为信用风险越高，保费就越贵。CDS价格往往比股价或信用评级更早变动，因此被视为预警信号。公司、银行甚至国家的CDS都受到市场关注。
businessTips.exampleEn: If a tech giant's 5-year CDS rises from 30 to 70 basis points, protecting $10 million of its bonds now costs $70,000 a year instead of $30,000. That doesn't mean default is likely, but it shows lenders are demanding more compensation, as seen with today's AI borrowing worries.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果某科技巨头的5年期CDS从30基点升到70基点，为1000万美元债券买保护的年成本就从3万美元涨到7万美元。这不代表它很可能违约，但说明债权人要求更多补偿，正如今天新闻中市场对AI举债的担忧。
